## Summary
What changed, and why?

## Issue / milestone
Closes #<issue-number>  
Milestone: P1 / P2 / P3 / maintenance

## Screenshots or demo
If UI or gameplay changed, attach screenshots or a short demonstration.

## Tests
- [ ] I tested locally or explained why a test is not currently possible.
- [ ] New behavior has appropriate tests, or the gap is documented.
- [ ] Existing CI checks are green.

Commands run / results:

## Review and safety
- [ ] No direct commit to `main`; change is on a task branch.
- [ ] At least one **other teammate** will review this PR.
- [ ] Changes to shared contracts were discussed with affected owners.
- [ ] No credentials, sensitive user data, private photos or datasets are included.
- [ ] Documentation updated for changed behavior or architecture.

## AI-assisted development (if applicable and permitted)
- AI used? Yes / No
- What did I verify myself?
- Related ADR (if required by course milestone):

## Reviewer notes
Risks, open questions, and any steps needed to reproduce the result.
